items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was me going back and borrowing from Illinois [Jacquet].

ctx.x: One thing that hit me on that album is it’s the first time I heard you go way above the natural range of the alto, almost into a place where you’re whistling, a whistling thing. Was – what was . . . ?

That was me going back and borrowing from Illinois [Jacquet]. Illinois was doing that in Jazz at the Philharmonic. I just decided to try it, and did it. Particularly on that day it seemed like I just started doing it and kept on doing it.
Then you got the stuff with . . .
